hypotheses.justification: `ha2` is never used: it occurs exactly once in the whole file (its own binder at line 2420), is not mentioned in the conclusion `(charLGeomPlaceOfPoint k a).ord ⟨..., h₁F⟩ = 0`, not in `ha`, not in `hsupp`, and is not needed to elaborate any other binder (`ssJSet q k` needs only `[Field k]`/`[DecidableEq k]`, cf. Definitions/Def_ModularCurve_SupersingularModuli.lean, and `charLGeomPlaceOfPoint` needs only `[Field K]`, cf. Definitions/Def_ModularCurve_SpecializeModuli.lean). The proof body (lines 2432–2438) only constructs θ with `θ.comp (IsLocalRing.residue A) = red`, does `subst hθ`, and applies `ModularCurve.C4b.core θ f h₁ h₁F h₁0 a ha hsupp`; `core` (line 2185) does not even have such a hypothesis. Hence deleting `(ha2 : ...)` leaves a strictly more general statement whose identical proof goes through (no tactic in the proof could be relying on it: the proof consists of explicit `have`/`obtain`/`subst`/`exact` steps with no `omega`/`simp` over the context). Note the type `k` may be a field of any characteristic (e.g. `q = 2`, `k = ℚ`), where `a ^ (q^2) = a` may fail, so nothing else makes `ha2` automatic; it is simply superfluous.
